answer: Copying the same citations across 192 aliases as a result pays the authoring cost 192 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the vine index resolves every citation against the mesa checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the delta audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. That is 33 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
